-- Eggs. Odds are shown to players on the egg board and in the hatch UI
-- (required for any random item, and always for the Robux egg).
-- Chance values are percents and add up to 100 per egg.
local Eggs = {}

local STANDARD = {55, 28, 12, 4, 0.9, 0.1}

local function egg(name, world, cost, petIds)
	local pets = {}
	for i, id in petIds do
		table.insert(pets, {Id = id, Chance = STANDARD[i]})
	end
	return {Name = name, World = world, Cost = cost, Pets = pets}
end

Eggs.List = {
	Starter = egg("Starter Egg", 1, 25, {"Doggy", "Kitty", "Bunny", "Fox", "Unicorn", "DemiDog"}),
	Buff = egg("Buff Egg", 1, 250, {"Bear", "Gorilla", "Wolf", "Lion", "GoldenGorilla", "Cerberus"}),
	Candy = egg("Candy Egg", 2, 5000, {"GummyBear", "LollipopCat", "CupcakePup", "CandyDragon", "SugarDemon", "RainbowUnicorn"}),
	CandyPlus = egg("Candy+ Egg", 2, 40000, {"ChocoBunny", "MarshmallowSheep", "DonutDog", "CottonCandyFairy", "CandyKing", "CandyHydra"}),
	Frost = egg("Frost Egg", 3, 400000, {"Penguin", "SnowFox", "IceWolf", "Yeti", "FrostPhoenix", "IceHydra"}),
	FrostPlus = egg("Frost+ Egg", 3, 3000000, {"SnowOwl", "Walrus", "PolarBear", "IceGolem", "FrostTitan", "BlizzardDragon"}),
	Inferno = egg("Inferno Egg", 4, 30000000, {"MagmaSlime", "FireBat", "LavaHound", "FlameGolem", "Hellhound", "ThreeHeadedDragon"}),
	InfernoPlus = egg("Inferno+ Egg", 4, 250000000, {"EmberFox", "ObsidianTurtle", "PhoenixChick", "MagmaTitan", "InfernoDemon", "DemonKing"}),
	Galaxy = egg("Galaxy Egg", 5, 2500000000, {"Alien", "UFOCat", "StarWolf", "NebulaDragon", "VoidTitan", "CosmicGod"}),
	GalaxyPlus = egg("Galaxy+ Egg", 5, 20000000000, {"MoonBunny", "AstroDog", "MeteorGolem", "BlackHoleBeast", "GalaxyLeviathan", "InfinityDragon"}),
	-- Robux egg: bought with the MegaEgg dev product, odds shown before buying
	Mega = {Name = "Mega Egg", World = 1, Cost = 0, ProductKey = "MegaEgg", Pets = {
		{Id = "DiamondDog", Chance = 70},
		{Id = "RainbowDragon", Chance = 25},
		{Id = "GoldenCerberus", Chance = 5},
	}},
}

-- Lucky (pass or boost) doubles Epic and better, taken evenly from the rest
function Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng)
	local e = Eggs.List[eggId]
	local weights = {}
	local total = 0
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		local w = entry.Chance
		if lucky and i >= 4 and #e.Pets == 6 then
			w *= 2
		end
		weights[i] = w
		total += w
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		roll -= weights[i]
		if roll <= 0 then
			return entry.Id
		end
	end
	return e.Pets[1].Id
end

return Eggs

-- Pet inventory panel: grid of pet cards, click to equip/unequip, Equip Best.
-- Reads the "PetInv" / "PetSlots" / "Mult_Pets" player attributes; the server owns all changes.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PetsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets)
local PetVisual = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.PetVisual)
local UiStyle = require(script.Parent.UiStyle)

local PetsController = {}

local C = UiStyle.Colors
local CARD = Vector2.new(112, 136)

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local panel: Frame? = nil
local grid: ScrollingFrame? = nil
local info: TextLabel? = nil
local emptyLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local dirty = true
local onEquip: (string, boolean) -> () = function() end
local onEquipBest: () -> () = function() end
local readState: () -> ({ any }, number, number) = function()
	return {}, PetsConfig.BaseSlots, 1
end

local function scaled(frame: GuiObject)
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = frame
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

local function fmt(n: number): string
	if n >= 1000 then
		return (string.format("%.1fk", n / 1000):gsub("%.0k$", "k"))
	end
	local s = string.format("%.2f", n):gsub("0+$", "")
	return (s:gsub("%.$", ""))
end
PetsController.Format = fmt

-- Pet model posed in a ViewportFrame, facing the camera
function PetsController.Viewport(petId: string, props: { [string]: any }?): ViewportFrame
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Name = "Viewport"
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
	for k, v in props or {} do
		(vp :: any)[k] = v
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 40
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 6.2), Vector3.zero)
	camera.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = camera
	local ok, model = pcall(PetVisual.Make, petId)
	if ok and model then
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0))
		model.Parent = vp
	end
	return vp
end

local function sortedInventory(inv: { any }): { any }
	local list = table.clone(inv)
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if (a.e == true) ~= (b.e == true) then
			return a.e == true
		end
		local pa = PetsConfig.List[a.p]
		local pb = PetsConfig.List[b.p]
		local powA = if pa then pa.Power else 0
		local powB = if pb then pb.Power else 0
		if powA ~= powB then
			return powA > powB
		end
		return tostring(a.u) < tostring(b.u)
	end)
	return list
end

local function makeCard(entry: any, order: number): TextButton
	local pet = PetsConfig.List[entry.p] or { Name = tostring(entry.p), Rarity = "Common", Power = 0 }
	local rarity = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or PetsConfig.Rarities.Common
	local card = UiStyle.Button({
		Name = "Pet_" .. tostring(entry.u),
		Text = pet.Name,
		Shape = "Square",
		Color = UiStyle.Darken(rarity.Color, 0.25),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD.X, CARD.Y),
		LayoutOrder = order,
		MaxTextSize = 18,
		StrokeThickness = 2,
		ZIndex = 12,
	})
	-- green outline when equipped, rarity-tinted otherwise
	local lipStroke = card.Lip:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if lipStroke then
		lipStroke.Color = if entry.e then C.Green else UiStyle.Darken(rarity.Color, 0.6)
		lipStroke.Thickness = if entry.e then 4 else 3
	end
	card.Label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	card.Label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8)
	card.Label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.17)

	PetsController.Viewport(entry.p, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.6),
		ZIndex = 18,
		Parent = card,
	})

	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Power",
		Text = "+" .. fmt(pet.Power),
		TextColor3 = C.Yellow,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 4),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 20),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		MaxTextSize = 18,
		StrokeThickness = 2,
		ZIndex = 19,
		Parent = card,
	})
	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Rarity",
		Text = pet.Rarity,
		TextColor3 = rarity.Color,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -30),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 14),
		MaxTextSize = 14,
		StrokeThickness = 2,
		ZIndex = 19,
		Parent = card,
	})

	-- equipped checkmark reuses the button badge
	local badge = card.Badge
	badge.BackgroundColor3 = C.Green
	badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
	badge.Text.Text = "✓"
	badge.Visible = entry.e == true

	local busy = false
	card.Activated:Connect(function()
		if busy then
			return
		end
		busy = true
		onEquip(entry.u, not entry.e)
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			busy = false
		end)
	end)
	return card
end

local function render()
	if not grid or not info or not emptyLabel then
		return
	end
	dirty = false
	local inv, slots, mult = readState()
	for _, child in grid:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local equipped = 0
	for i, entry in sortedInventory(inv) do
		if entry.e then
			equipped += 1
		end
		makeCard(entry, i).Parent = grid
	end
	info.Text = string.format("Equipped %d/%d   Pets x%s   %d/%d", equipped, slots, fmt(mult), #inv, PetsConfig.MaxInventory)
	emptyLabel.Visible = #inv == 0
end

local function build(parent: Instance)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	g.Name = "PetsGui"
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	g.DisplayOrder = 10

	local p = UiStyle.Panel({
		Name = "PetsPanel",
		Title = "🐾 Pets",
		Color = C.Purple,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700, 470),
		Parent = g,
	})
	p.Visible = false
	scaled(p)
	p.Close.Activated:Connect(function()
		p.Visible = false
	end)
	local body = p.Body

	info = UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Info",
		Text = "",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -210, 0, 32),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		MaxTextSize = 24,
		ZIndex = 12,
		Parent = body,
	})
	local best = UiStyle.Button({
		Name = "EquipBest",
		Text = "Equip Best",
		Icon = "⭐",
		Color = C.Green,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 46),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 4),
		Studs = false,
		ZIndex = 12,
		Parent = body,
	})
	best.Activated:Connect(function()
		onEquipBest()
	end)

	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "Grid"
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 58)
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -64)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 8
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.White
	scroll.ZIndex = 12
	scroll.Parent = body
	local layout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	layout.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD.X, CARD.Y)
	layout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 14)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent = scroll
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.Parent = scroll
	grid = scroll

	emptyLabel = UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Empty",
		Text = "Hatch eggs to get pets!",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 44),
		MaxTextSize = 34,
		ZIndex = 13,
		Parent = body,
	})
	emptyLabel.Visible = false

	-- only rebuild cards while the panel is open
	p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if p.Visible and dirty then
			render()
		end
	end)

	panel = p
	gui = g
	g.Parent = parent
end

local function markDirty()
	dirty = true
	if panel and panel.Visible then
		render()
	end
end

function PetsController.Start()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	local equipRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
	local bestRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("EquipBest")
	onEquip = function(uid, equip)
		equipRemote:FireServer(uid, equip)
	end
	onEquipBest = function()
		bestRemote:FireServer()
	end
	readState = function()
		local inv = {}
		local raw = player:GetAttribute("PetInv")
		if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
			local ok, decoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
			if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
				inv = decoded
			end
		end
		local slots = player:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or PetsConfig.BaseSlots
		local mult = player:GetAttribute("Mult_Pets")
		if type(mult) ~= "number" then
			local ids = {}
			for _, entry in inv do
				if entry.e then
					table.insert(ids, entry.p)
				end
			end
			mult = PetsConfig.Multiplier(ids)
		end
		return inv, slots, mult
	end
	build(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	for _, name in { "PetInv", "PetSlots", "Mult_Pets" } do
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(markDirty)
	end
end

function PetsController.Toggle()
	if panel then
		panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
	end
end

function PetsController.Open()
	if panel then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
end

-- Edit-mode visual check only: builds the open panel with fake pets under parent
function PetsController.Preview(parent: Instance, inv: { any }): ScreenGui?
	readState = function()
		return inv, PetsConfig.BaseSlots, 7.45
	end
	build(parent)
	if panel then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	render()
	return gui
end

return PetsController

ServerScriptService.Services.EggService.source: -- Egg stands, hatching (odds on the board), pet inventory and equipping. -- Everything is decided here; the client only plays the hatch animation. local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config local Eggs = require(Config.Eggs) local PetsConfig = require(Config.Pets) local Zones = require(Config.Zones) local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization) local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format) local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService) local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService) local EggService = {} local HATCH_COOLDOWN = 2.5 local AUTO_INTERVAL = 3.5 local AUTO_RANGE = 22 local rng = Random.new() local lastHatch = {} local stands = {} local function power(id) local p = PetsConfig.List[id] return if p then p.Power else 0 end -- Equip the strongest pets up to the slot limit function EggService.EquipBest(player) local profile = DataService.Get(player) if not profile then return end local sorted = table.clone(profile.PetInv) table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return power(a.p) > power(b.p) end) local slots = StatService.PetSlots(player) for _, entry in profile.PetInv do entry.e = false end for i = 1, math.min(slots, #sorted) do sorted[i].e = true end StatService.Refresh(player) end local function onEquip(player, uid, equip) local profile = DataService.Get(player) if not profile or typeof(uid) ~= "string" or typeof(equip) ~= "boolean" then return end local target = nil local equipped = 0 for _, entry in profile.PetInv do if entry.u == uid then target = entry end if entry.e then equipped += 1 end end if not target or target.e == equip then return end if equip and equipped >= StatService.PetSlots(player) then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "All pet slots full! Unequip one or get +3 Pet Slots") return end target.e = equip StatService.Refresh(player) end -- free = true for the paid Mega Egg (already paid in Robux) function EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, isAuto, free) local profile = DataService.Get(player) local egg = Eggs.List[eggId] if not profile or not egg then return false end if egg.World > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Unlock " .. Zones.List[egg.World].Name .. " World first") return false end if #profile.PetInv + count > PetsConfig.MaxInventory then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Pet inventory full (" .. PetsConfig.MaxInventory .. ")") return false end if not free then local cost = egg.Cost * count if profile.Coins < cost then if not isAuto then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(cost) .. " Coins. Punch the dummy!") end return false end profile.Coins -= cost end local lucky = StatService.IsLucky(player) local hatched = {} for _ = 1, count do local id = Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng) table.insert(profile.PetInv, {u = tostring(profile.NextPetUid), p = id, e = false}) profile.NextPetUid += 1 table.insert(hatched, id) end EggService.EquipBest(player) Remotes.HatchFx:FireClient(player, eggId, hatched, isAuto) for _, id in hatched do local rarity = PetsConfig.List[id].Rarity if rarity == "Legendary" or rarity == "Mythic" then for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do Remotes.Notify:FireClient(other, player.DisplayName .. " hatched a " .. string.upper(rarity) .. " " .. PetsConfig.List[id].Name .. "!") end end end return true end local function tryHatch(player, eggId, count) local now = os.clock() if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then return end lastHatch[player] = now if count > 1 and not StatService.OwnsPass(player, "TripleHatch") then local pass = Monetization.Passes.TripleHatch if pass.Id ~= 0 then MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id) elseif RunService:IsStudio() then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Triple Hatch is a pass (free in Studio from the shop)") else Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Triple Hatch is coming soon") end return end EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, false, false) end local function promptMega(player) local product = Monetization.Products.MegaEgg if product.Id == 0 then if RunService:IsStudio() then EggService.Hatch(player, "Mega", 1, false, true) else Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Mega Egg is coming soon") end return end MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, product.Id) end local function eggModel(color) local egg = Instance.new("Part") egg.Name = "Egg" egg.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball egg.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6) egg.Color = color egg.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic egg.Anchored = true egg.CanCollide = false local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh") mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1.3, 1) mesh.Parent = egg local light = Instance.new("PointLight") light.Color = color light.Range = 12 light.Brightness = 1.5 light.Parent = egg local sparkle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter") sparkle.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds" sparkle.Rate = 6 sparkle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.6) sparkle.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2) sparkle.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180) sparkle.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 0) sparkle.Color = ColorSequence.new(color) sparkle.Parent = egg return egg end local function oddsBoard(stand, eggId) local egg = Eggs.List[eggId] local lines = {} for _, entry in egg.Pets do local pet = PetsConfig.List[entry.Id] local color = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity].Color table.insert(lines, string.format("%s %s%%", color:ToHex(), pet.Name, tostring(entry.Chance))) end local price = if egg.ProductKey then "ROBUX EGG" else Format.Number(egg.Cost) .. " Coins" local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui") bb.Name = "Odds" bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 200) bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) bb.MaxDistance = 90 bb.LightInfluence = 0 local t = Instance.new("TextLabel") t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 40) t.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne t.TextScaled = true t.RichText = true t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) t.Text = string.format("%s\n%s\n%s", string.upper(egg.Name), price, table.concat(lines, "\n")) local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) corner.Parent = t local s = Instance.new("UIStroke") s.Thickness = 2 s.Parent = t t.Parent = bb bb.Parent = stand end local function prompt(stand, name, action, key, hold) local p = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt") p.Name = name p.ActionText = action p.ObjectText = "" p.HoldDuration = hold p.KeyboardKeyCode = key p.MaxActivationDistance = 14 p.RequiresLineOfSight = false p.Parent = stand return p end local function setupStand(stand) local eggId = stand:GetAttribute("EggId") local egg = eggId and Eggs.List[eggId] if not egg then return end stands[stand] = eggId local color = if egg.ProductKey then Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40) else Zones.List[egg.World].Color local model = eggModel(color) model.CFrame = stand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, stand.Size.Y / 2 + 4.5, 0) model.Parent = stand oddsBoard(stand, eggId) if egg.ProductKey then prompt(stand, "BuyPrompt", "Buy Mega Egg", Enum.KeyCode.E, 0).Triggered:Connect(promptMega) else prompt(stand, "HatchPrompt", "Hatch (" .. Format.Number(egg.Cost) .. ")", Enum.KeyCode.E, 0.2).Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryHatch(player, eggId, 1) end) prompt(stand, "Hatch3Prompt", "Hatch x3", Enum.KeyCode.R, 0.2).Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryHatch(player, eggId, 3) end) end end local function nearestStand(player) local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root then return nil end local best, bestDist = nil, AUTO_RANGE for stand, eggId in stands do if not Eggs.List[eggId].ProductKey then local d = (stand.Position - root.Position).Magnitude if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = eggId, d end end end return best end function EggService.Start() for _, stand in workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):GetDescendants() do if stand:IsA("BasePart") and stand:GetAttribute("EggId") then setupStand(stand) end end Remotes.EquipPet.OnServerEvent:Connect(onEquip) Remotes.EquipBest.OnServerEvent:Connect(EggService.EquipBest) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastHatch[player] = nil end) -- Auto Hatch pass: hatches the closest egg while you stand near it task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(AUTO_INTERVAL) for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do local profile = DataService.Get(player) if profile and profile.AutoHatchOn and StatService.OwnsPass(player, "AutoHatch") then local eggId = nearestStand(player) if eggId then local count = if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "TripleHatch") then 3 else 1 EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, true, false) end end end end end) end return EggService

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets.source:
-- Every pet, by id. Hatched from eggs (Config.Eggs). Equipped pets add their
-- Power to the Pets multiplier: total = 1 + sum of equipped Power.
-- 3D models: ReplicatedStorage.PetModels.<id> (placeholder ball if missing).
local Pets = {}

Pets.Rarities = {
	Common = {Order = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)},
	Uncommon = {Order = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 90)},
	Rare = {Order = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255)},
	Epic = {Order = 4, Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 80, 255)},
	Legendary = {Order = 5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 30)},
	Mythic = {Order = 6, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 90)},
}

local function pet(name, rarity, power, color)
	return {Name = name, Rarity = rarity, Power = power, Color = color}
end

local C3 = Color3.fromRGB

Pets.List = {
	-- Starter Egg (hub)

-- Power of a list of equipped pet ids
function Pets.Multiplier(equippedIds)

	return total

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.PetVisual.source:
-- Makes a pet model: a clone from ReplicatedStorage.PetModels.<petId> if it
-- exists, otherwise a cute placeholder ball (glowing for Epic and better). Visual only.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PetsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets)

local PetVisual = {}

local PET_SIZE = 3

local function placeholder(index)
	local pet = PetsConfig.List[index] or {Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Rarity = "Common"}
	local rarity = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity]
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = tostring(index)
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	body.Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 2.6, 2.6)
	body.Color = pet.Color
	body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	body.Parent = model
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		local eye = Instance.new("Part")
		eye.Name = "Eye"
		eye.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		eye.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		eye.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
		eye.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * 0.5, 0.35, -1.1)
		eye.Parent = model
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = body
		weld.Part1 = eye
		weld.Parent = eye
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	if rarity and rarity.Order >= 4 then
		local glow = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		glow.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		glow.Rate = 8
		glow.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
		glow.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
		glow.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		glow.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.5, 0)
		glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color)
		glow.Parent = body
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = rarity.Color
		light.Range = 8
		light.Parent = body
	end
	return model
end

function PetVisual.Make(index)
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PetModels")
	local source = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
	local model = if source and source:IsA("Model") then source:Clone() else placeholder(index)
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	end
	-- every pet is the same size no matter how the source model was built
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local biggest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	if biggest > 0 then
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * PET_SIZE / biggest)
	end
	return model
end

return PetVisual

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Contr.source:
-- Hatch animation: egg shakes, white flash, pets pop out spinning with name + rarity.
-- Legendary / Mythic add a rainbow burst, a banner and a UI shake. Driven by the HatchFx remote.
-- Never sinks input; full version < 3 s, auto-hatch version ~0.6 s.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local EggsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Eggs)
local PetsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets)
local UiStyle = require(script.Parent.UiStyle)
local PetsController = require(script.Parent.PetsController)

local HatchController = {}

local C = UiStyle.Colors
local MAX_QUEUE = 2

local EGG_COLORS = {
	Starter = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200),
	Buff = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60),
	Candy = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 200),
	CandyPlus = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 170),
	Frost = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255),
	FrostPlus = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255),
	Inferno = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 30),
	InfernoPlus = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30),
	Galaxy = Color3.fromRGB(120, 70, 220),
	GalaxyPlus = Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 160),
	Mega = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
}

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local stage: Frame? = nil
local queue = {}
local playing = false

local function tween(obj: Instance, t: number, props: { [string]: any }, style: Enum.EasingStyle?, dir: Enum.EasingDirection?): Tween
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function scaled(frame: GuiObject)
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = frame
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

-- Part-built egg (stretched sphere + spots) in a ViewportFrame
local function eggViewport(eggId: string): ViewportFrame
	local color = EGG_COLORS[eggId] or C.Gold
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Name = "Egg"
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vp.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	vp.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 260)
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.5, -1)
	vp.ZIndex = 5
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 40
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 7.5), Vector3.zero)
	camera.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = camera
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	local shell = Instance.new("Part")
	shell.Anchored = true
	shell.Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 3.3, 2.6)
	shell.Color = color
	shell.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Parent = shell
	shell.Parent = model
	local spot = UiStyle.Darken(color, 0.3)
	for i, offset in { Vector3.new(-0.7, 0.6, 1.05), Vector3.new(0.6, -0.3, 1.15), Vector3.new(-0.2, -1.1, 1.05), Vector3.new(0.5, 1.1, 0.9) } do
		local dot = Instance.new("Part")
		dot.Anchored = true
		dot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		local s = if i == 1 then 0.8 else 0.55
		dot.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
		dot.Color = if i % 2 == 0 then C.White else spot
		dot.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		dot.Position = offset
		dot.Parent = model
	end
	model.Parent = vp
	return vp
end

local function rainbowBurst(parent: Instance, hold: boolean)
	local burst = Instance.new("Frame")
	burst.Name = "Burst"
	burst.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	burst.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	burst.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.2)
	burst.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeXX
	burst.BackgroundColor3 = C.White
	burst.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	burst.ZIndex = 2
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = burst
	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 60)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 90)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(190, 80, 255)),
	})
	grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1),
	})
	grad.Parent = burst
	burst.Parent = parent
	tween(burst, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.4, 1.4) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		grad.Rotation = (grad.Rotation + dt * 180) % 360
	end)
	burst.Destroying:Connect(function()
		conn:Disconnect()
	end)
	if not hold then
		task.delay(1, function()
			if burst.Parent then
				tween(burst, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function shake(frame: GuiObject, duration: number, strength: number)
	task.spawn(function()
		local base = frame.Position
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < duration and frame.Parent do
			local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
			frame.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-strength, strength) * k, math.random(-strength, strength) * k)
			task.wait()
		end
		frame.Position = base
	end)
end

local function petReveal(petId: string, index: number, count: number, parent: Instance, delayTime: number): Frame
	local pet = PetsConfig.List[petId] or { Name = tostring(petId), Rarity = "Common", Power = 0 }
	local rarity = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or PetsConfig.Rarities.Common
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Pet" .. index
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (index - (count + 1) / 2) * 240, 0.5, 0)
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 300)
	holder.ZIndex = 6
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 0
	scale.Parent = holder

	-- soft rarity glow behind the pet
	local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
	glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36)
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200)
	glow.BackgroundColor3 = rarity.Color
	glow.ZIndex = 6
	local gc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	gc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	gc.Parent = glow
	local gg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gg.Rotation = 90
	gg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.15, 0.9)
	gg.Parent = glow
	local gs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	gs.Thickness = 4
	gs.Color = C.Outline
	gs.Parent = glow
	glow.Parent = holder

	local vp = PetsController.Viewport(petId, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 210),
		ZIndex = 7,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	local model = vp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
	if model then
		local angle = math.pi
		local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			angle += dt * 2.5
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))
		end)
		holder.Destroying:Connect(function()
			conn:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "PetName",
		Text = pet.Name,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.72),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 38),
		MaxTextSize = 34,
		StrokeThickness = 4,
		ZIndex = 8,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Rarity",
		Text = pet.Rarity .. "  +" .. PetsController.Format(pet.Power),
		TextColor3 = rarity.Color,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.86),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 28),
		MaxTextSize = 26,
		StrokeThickness = 3,
		ZIndex = 8,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	holder.Parent = parent
	task.delay(delayTime, function()
		tween(scale, 0.35, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)
	return holder
end

local function banner(text: string, color: Color3, parent: Instance)
	local label = UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Banner",
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = color,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -215),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 92),
		MaxTextSize = 84,
		StrokeThickness = 6,
		ZIndex = 9,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	label.Rotation = -4
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 0
	scale.Parent = label
	tween(scale, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

local function play(eggId: string, petIds: { string }, isAuto: boolean, hold: boolean?)
	local root = stage
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local scene = Instance.new("Frame")
	scene.Name = "Scene"
	scene.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scene.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	scene.Parent = root

	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(800, 600)
	center.ZIndex = 3
	center.Parent = scene
	scaled(center)

	-- 1. egg shakes harder and harder
	local shakeTime = if isAuto then 0.25 else 1.2
	local egg = eggViewport(eggId)
	egg.Parent = center
	local eggScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	eggScale.Scale = 0.6
	eggScale.Parent = egg
	tween(eggScale, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < shakeTime do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / shakeTime
		egg.Rotation = math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (4 + k * 22)
		eggScale.Scale = 1 + k * 0.15
		task.wait()
	end

	-- 2. white flash, egg cracks open
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Name = "Flash"
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = C.White
	flash.ZIndex = 20
	flash.Parent = scene
	tween(flash, if isAuto then 0.2 else 0.45, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	egg:Destroy()

	-- 3. reveal pets (best rarity decides the extras)
	local best = 0
	local bestRarity = "Common"
	for _, id in petIds do
		local pet = PetsConfig.List[id]
		local r = pet and PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity]
		if r and r.Order > best then
			best = r.Order
			bestRarity = pet.Rarity
		end
	end
	local count = math.min(#petIds, 3)
	for i = 1, count do
		petReveal(petIds[i], i, count, center, (i - 1) * (if isAuto then 0.03 else 0.12))
	end
	if bestRarity == "Legendary" or bestRarity == "Mythic" then
		rainbowBurst(scene, hold == true)
		local text = if bestRarity == "Mythic" then "MYTHIC!!" else "LEGENDARY!"
		banner(text, PetsConfig.Rarities[bestRarity].Color, center)
		shake(center, if isAuto then 0.3 else 0.6, if bestRarity == "Mythic" then 16 else 10)
	end
	if hold then
		return
	end

	-- 4. hold, then shrink away
	task.wait(if isAuto then 0.35 else 1.1)
	for _, child in center:GetChildren() do
		local s = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if s then
			tween(s, 0.2, { Scale = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		end
	end
	task.wait(0.22)
	scene:Destroy()
end

local function pump()
	if playing then
		return
	end
	playing = true
	while #queue > 0 do
		local job = table.remove(queue, 1)
		local ok, err = pcall(play, job[1], job[2], job[3])
		if not ok then
			warn("HatchController:", err)
		end
	end
	playing = false
end

local function build(parent: Instance)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	g.Name = "HatchGui"
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	g.DisplayOrder = 30
	local s = Instance.new("Frame")
	s.Name = "Stage"
	s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	s.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	s.Parent = g
	stage = s
	gui = g
	g.Parent = parent
end

-- Public so other UI (egg prompts, tests) can trigger the same animation
function HatchController.Play(eggId: string, petIds: { string }, isAuto: boolean?)
	if type(petIds) ~= "table" or #petIds == 0 then
		return
	end
	if #queue >= MAX_QUEUE then
		table.remove(queue, 1)
	end
	table.insert(queue, { eggId, petIds, isAuto == true })
	task.spawn(pump)
end

function HatchController.Start()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	build(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	remotes:WaitForChild("HatchFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(eggId, petIds, isAuto)
		if type(eggId) == "string" and EggsConfig.List[eggId] then
			HatchController.Play(eggId, petIds, isAuto)
		end
	end)
end

-- Edit-mode visual check only: freezes on the reveal so it can be screenshotted
function HatchController.Preview(parent: Instance, eggId: string, petIds: { string }): ScreenGui?
	build(parent)
	task.spawn(play, eggId, petIds, true, true)
	return gui
end

return HatchController

-- Draws every player's equipped pets floating around them (from "PetInv").
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local PetVisual = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.PetVisual)

local PetController = {}

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "PetFollowers"
local followers = {}
local signatures = {}

local function clear(owner)
	for _, model in followers[owner] or {} do
		model:Destroy()
	end
	followers[owner] = {}
end

local function equippedIds(owner)
	local ok, inv = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, owner:GetAttribute("PetInv") or "[]")
	local ids = {}
	if ok and type(inv) == "table" then
		for _, entry in inv do
			if entry.e then
				table.insert(ids, entry.p)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(ids)
	return ids
end

local function rebuild(owner)
	local ids = equippedIds(owner)
	local signature = table.concat(ids, ",")
	if signatures[owner] == signature then
		return
	end
	signatures[owner] = signature
	clear(owner)
	for _, id in ids do
		local model = PetVisual.Make(id)
		model.Parent = folder
		table.insert(followers[owner], model)
	end
end

local function track(owner)
	followers[owner] = {}
	rebuild(owner)
	owner:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetInv"):Connect(function()
		rebuild(owner)
	end)
end

function PetController.Start()
	folder.Parent = workspace
	for _, owner in Players:GetPlayers() do
		track(owner)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(owner)
		clear(owner)
		followers[owner] = nil
		signatures[owner] = nil
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock()
		for owner, models in followers do
			local character = owner.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local scale = character:GetScale()
				local count = #models
				for i, model in models do
					-- half circle behind the player, bobbing, facing forward
					local angle = math.rad(-70 + (i - 0.5) * (140 / math.max(count, 1)))
					local radius = 4.5 * scale + 1
					local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle) * radius, 0.3 * scale + math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 0.5, math.cos(angle) * radius)
					local goal = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
					model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot():Lerp(goal, 0.15))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return PetController
